images.screen: A · 넷째 밤 — exhibits turning into my belongings
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. A quiet side-on, diorama-like view of a modern history museum gallery at 3 a.m., rendered in clean flat vector illustration with soft gradients. Cold slate-blue walls, tall mullioned windows letting moonlight fall in long pale diagonal shafts across the wall and floor. A row of six white plinths with glass vitrine hoods: some hold real antiquities (a green bronze mirror, a grey-brown stoneware jar, tiny gold earrings) lit coolly, while others now hold ordinary personal belongings under warm tungsten spotlights — a chipped white mug, a father's leather-strap wristwatch stopped at 3:12, a bunch of house keys with a red tag. A dark silhouette of the night guard stands at the left edge with a faint flashlight beam. A cream museum placard in serif Korean type reads "머그컵" with a small orange note of what used to be there. A minimal counter "7 / 20" with small glowing dots. Still, uncanny, melancholic. HUD constraint: under "7 / 20" there are exactly 20 small dots with the first 7 glowing; the wristwatch hands point to 3:12. STRICT (retry): the dot row directly under "7 / 20" contains exactly twenty dots in one line — seven bright glowing dots on the left followed by thirteen dim dots — no more and no fewer; count them. Background constraint: wall posters and banners show only abstract patterns or plain text panels; do NOT depict any real-world building, monument, ruin, landmark or historical photograph (in particular no domed ruin).

images.screen: B · 마지막 밤 — the whole room is my home, and one case is empty
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. The same moonlit museum gallery in flat vector style, slate blue with pale diagonal moonbeams, but now the entire room has become an exhibition of one person's apartment behind navy velvet ropes on chrome stanchions: a narrow bed with a half-folded blanket, a coat stand with a navy security-guard uniform jacket, a small wooden kitchen table with two chairs (one pushed in) holding a mug and keys, a stopped wall clock, a framed faded family photo of three people. Each piece has a small cream placard. On the right, a tall empty glass vitrine on a white plinth, lit by a warm spotlight, reflecting the faint ghostly silhouette of the guard holding a flashlight. A cream placard beneath it reads "경비원, 34세". Thin spaced Korean title at the top "한 사람의 방". Quiet, devastating, gallery-minimal composition. Text constraints: the stopped wall clock shows 3:12 and its placard reads exactly "멈춘 시간 · 3:12"; no calendar date or year anywhere.
